text:
Priya: Quick heads up  nightly preview shows a 1.7% upside for cohort-D after the new price-sheet merge. opening thread to confirm scope.
Noah: Is that total projected rev or just a segment?
Priya: Total projected ARR for the experiment window. seems concentrated in 7 mid-size accounts.
Lena: Any sample account ids we can diff?
Priya: samples: M-2201, M-3388, M-4410.
Noah: I'll run gateway -> pricing -> preview diffs for those ids. could be a rounding or tier boundary bug.
Ethan: Product asks we pause new cohort enrollments until we confirm. prefer not to pause existing traffic.
Priya: I'll disable the enrollment job enrollments-2024-05-01 and stop preview-email sends.
Lena: Found one issue: price-sheet contained both `legacy_credit` and `legacyCredit` for some rows. our merge prioritized the wrong key so a few accounts lost legacy discounts. patching merge to prefer stored customer flags over sheet values.
Noah: That would inflate previews if legacy discounts get removed. good catch.
Priya: Finance: set thresholds - if delta >1% hold canary; 0.25-1% allow 25% enrollment cap; <0.25% proceed.
Ethan: Agreed. product ok with 25% cap if between thresholds.
Lena: Patch deployed to staging. running backfill to recompute previews for affected accounts. backfill ETA ~22m.
CS-Bot: Scanned outbound preview emails: none sent to customers, two internal test previews were shared.
billing-bot: Incident FIN-2410 created: "pricing merge key precedence caused legacy flag drops" assigned to Lena (P2). https://redwood.example/incidents/FIN-2410
Noah: Backfill done. per-account diffs show aggregate projected delta 0.32%. detailed CSV uploaded to FIN-2410.
Priya: Delta in 0.25-1% band. re-enabling enrollments with 25% cap and will rerun final reconciliation tomorrow morning.
Ethan: Product signs off on cap. Priya please prepare a short CS message template in case previews leaked. Legal on standby.
Lena: Adding postmortem items: enforce field normalization on merge, prefer stored flags, add CI to detect key collisions in incoming sheets.
Priya: Thanks team. will update FIN-2410 with final reconciliation tomorrow. :thumbsup:
